scope: Illustrative rigid-body kinematics and valve sequencing, not measured valve capacity or cylinder thermodynamics

checks.name: A chamber cannot admit and exhaust simultaneously
Piston stays within the head clearances
Connecting rod has constant length through the whole revolution
All five explanatory valve phases occur
Downstroke admits above the piston and exhausts below
Upstroke admits below the piston and exhausts above
Same head line reverses between the two strokes
Cutoff closes admission while expansion continues
Rod-side volume accounts for the 24 mm rod
Full turns preserve the cycle state
